aiCost.title: AI Cost
aiCost.subtitle: OpenAI consumption, caching, and credit runway
aiCost.estimateNote: These figures are our estimate from logged production traffic — not the OpenAI invoice (which also includes eval/dev). The billing section below shows authoritative numbers.
aiCost.empty: No AI activity in this period
aiCost.billingEmpty: No billing snapshots yet — the daily sync hasn't run, or the OpenAI admin key isn't configured.
aiCost.syncNotConfigured: Set OPENAI_ADMIN_API_KEY first — nothing to sync.
aiCost.reconcNote: “Difference” compares the production key against our logged estimate (should be near 0%). The org total also includes eval/dev usage, which isn't customer traffic.
aiCost.runwayNotConfigured: Set your current OpenAI credit balance below to see how many days it lasts at the current spend rate.
aiCost.runwayParkingTitle: OpenAI credit is out — replies are parking right now
aiCost.runwayBannerDetail: Estimated {remaining} left — about {days} days at {rate}/day. Top up before it reaches zero.
aiCost.runwayBannerDetailNoRate: Estimated {remaining} left. Top up before it reaches zero — the days-of-runway estimate appears once billing data syncs.
aiCost.runwayBannerParking: Replies are parked until OpenAI credit is added. Top up now to resume.
aiCost.autoRechargeHint: Tip: enable auto-recharge in the OpenAI billing dashboard so credit never hits zero — this panel is the backup warning.
aiCost.spikeNotice: ⚠ Spend spike on {day}: {dayUsd} vs a {baseline}/day baseline ({ratio}). Check for a runaway loop, model misconfig, or unusual traffic.

customer.title: Customer Details
customer.pageOffAutoPaused: Auto-reply off — paused after send failures
customer.whatsappCoexistence: Also live on the merchant's WhatsApp Business app
customer.aiModelHint: Override the AI model used for this workspace. Leave on default unless running a deliberate cost/quality experiment.
customer.aiModelConfirm: Switch this workspace to {model}? Quality may differ from the default. The change is auditable and reversible.
customer.topupExternalRefPlaceholder: e.g., bank transaction ID, USDT TXID
customer.topupSuccess: Credited {replies, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}. New balance: {balance, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}.
customer.topupPendingConflict: This customer has {count, plural, one {# card payment} other {# card payments}} still in progress that may complete and credit on its own. Crediting manually now may double-credit them. Force only if this credit is unrelated to that payment.
customer.paymentSubtitle: Generate a Stripe link to bill this customer for replies you already credited by hand. Paying it never adds replies — it only records the payment.
customer.paymentAmountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
customer.paymentLinkReady: Payment link created — send it to the customer:
customer.aiCostEmpty: No AI activity in this period
customer.aiCostBilledHint: “Billed” = real OpenAI calls. Cache hits are served for free, so a page can show many replies but a small cost.
customer.flag_no_pages: No connected page — this merchant can't receive any replies.
customer.flag_ai_disabled: AI replies are turned off (master switch).
customer.flag_channel_silent: {channel, select, comments {Comment auto-reply is off} messages {Message auto-reply is off} other {A reply channel is off}}.
customer.flag_page_disconnected: Page disconnected — the access token was cleared; needs reconnecting.
customer.flag_auto_reply_system_off: Auto-reply was turned off by the system ({reason, select, trial_block {trial limit} plan_limit {plan limit} auto_pause {auto-paused} other {unknown}}).
customer.flag_auto_reply_user_off: The merchant turned auto-reply off for this page.
customer.flag_kb_empty: Business Info is empty — the AI has nothing to answer from.
customer.flag_no_offering_chunks: No products or prices in Business Info — the AI can't answer pricing questions.
customer.flag_subscription_inactive: Auto-replies are blocked by the subscription gate. DB status: {status, select, past_due {past due} canceled {canceled} active {active — a manual plan that has passed its coverage end} other {inactive}}.
customer.flag_subscription_past_due_grace: Payment is past due — replies are still sending during the {daysLeft, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left of the retry window, then they stop.
customer.flag_usage_near_cap: Usage at {percent}% of the monthly limit ({used}/{limit}).
customer.flag_usage_on_topup: Monthly plan limit reached ({used}/{limit}) — replies keep sending from the top-up balance ({balance} left).
customer.flag_usage_topup_nearly_drained: Monthly plan limit reached ({used}/{limit}) and only {balance} top-up replies are left — replies stop when the balance runs out.
customer.flag_usage_near_cap_on_topup: Usage at {percent}% of the monthly limit ({used}/{limit}) — once the limit is reached, the available top-up replies are used automatically.
customer.flag_limit_fallback_off: Near the reply limit and the limit-reached message is off — replies will go silent at the cap.
customer.flag_trial_ending_soon: {daysLeft, plural, one {Trial ends in # day} other {Trial ends in # days}}.
customer.flag_persona_placeholder: Persona / brand voice is not set (still a placeholder).
customer.flag_hold_low_confidence: Low-confidence replies are held for manual review.
customer.flag_timezone_default: Timezone is still the default — business hours may be offset.
customer.flag_no_away_message: Business-hours-only is on but no away message is set.
customer.flag_greeting_written_not_enabled: A greeting message is written but the greeting is turned off.
customer.flag_unresolved_kb_gaps: {count, plural, one {# customer question the Business Info couldn't answer} other {# customer questions the Business Info couldn't answer}}.
customer.flag_merchant_dormant: {days, plural, one {Last active # day ago} other {Last active # days ago}}.
customer.flag_team_member: This user is a team member in another workspace — the settings shown are not the ones driving replies (the owner's are).
customer.flag_settings_untouched: Settings were never customized — everything is at default.
customer.settingsNeverCreated: This merchant has never saved settings — all defaults apply.
customer.settingsLegacyFallbackWarn: Live pipeline settings couldn't be loaded — the values below come from the raw saved row and may not match what auto-reply is actually doing.
customer.personaPlaceholderWarn: The persona still contains placeholder text — the merchant hasn't set their brand voice.
customer.kbEmpty: Business Info is empty — nothing for the AI to answer from.
customer.kbNoOfferings: No products or prices — the AI can't answer pricing questions.
customer.kbGapsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unanswered questions} one {# unanswered question} other {# unanswered questions}}
customer.kbAuditPartial: Only the automatic checks ran. The instruction classifier failed, so unrunnable rules were NOT checked — this is not a clean result.
customer.kbAuditClean: No unrunnable instructions and no data problems found.
customer.kbAuditCode_lead_status_change: Asks Jawab to change a lead's status. Only the Leads page can do that, so this line has no effect.
customer.kbAuditCode_conditional_silence: Asks Jawab not to reply to certain messages. Business Info is what Jawab answers from — it cannot decide whether Jawab answers.
customer.kbAuditCode_human_handoff: Asks Jawab to hand the chat to a person. Handoff starts when the merchant replies manually; Jawab cannot start it.
customer.kbAuditCode_collect_payment: Asks Jawab to take payment or send a payment link. It cannot charge the merchant's customers.
customer.kbAuditCode_scheduled_message: Asks Jawab to send something later. Follow-up timing is system-controlled and cannot be set here.
customer.kbAuditCode_image_url_not_direct: This link opens a page, not an image file, so no picture appears for the customer.
customer.kbAuditCode_duplicate_row: The same row is listed twice — the two copies will drift apart on the next edit.
customer.kbAuditCode_conflicting_row: The same row appears with two different values, so Jawab can quote either one.
customer.emailNoAddress: This merchant has no email address on file.
customer.emailBodyPlaceholder: Write your message to the merchant…
customer.emailRequiredFields: Subject and message are both required.
customer.emailErrorGeneric: Couldn't send the email. Please try again.
customer.flag_all_channels_silent: Both comment and message auto-reply are off — the merchant is fully silent.
customer.flag_auto_reply_off_unknown: Auto-reply is off for this page (no recorded reason).
customer.flag_hold_low_confidence_weak_kb: Low-confidence replies are held for review — and the Business Info is empty/thin, so most replies will be held (customers get little back).
customer.flag_kb_thin: Business Info is thin — the AI has little to answer from.
